Updated the Treasury Bulletin yields skill and memory.

Key generalizable fix:
OfficeQA’s “Fisher Ideal symmetric growth rate” for these yield questions should use the midpoint/arc formula:

g = 2 * (new - old) / (new + old)

not the geometric-mean denominator formula:

(new - old) / sqrt(new * old)

I also added a sanity check for the recurring FY-end 1982 case:
August 1982 Treasury bonds = 12.15
August 1981 Treasury bonds = 13.61
Arc/Fisher symmetric growth = -0.113354..., rounded to -0.113.
